<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/execution/session"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The most recent `active` session that already carries `execution.activated` — the SAME criterion `activate` uses to decide whether to reactivate or create one (RN-139). `null` when no execution is in progress. Exists so the Executors tab stops inferring this session from the project's most recent one, which shifts from session to session with no clue at all in the UI.
